applications/ch01.txt: Pass both and the holding is cooperative. Fail either and it is parasitic. The verdict reads the worse of the two.
applications/ch02.txt: Law is what the shared structure does to keep the room viable in the face of actions that shrink it.
applications/ch03.txt: Governance is the engineering of one boundary.
applications/ch04.txt: The optimal economy is the one whose joint viable set is widest without parasitic accumulation in the buffer.
applications/ch05.txt: Medicine is what the larger structure does, at the minimum level required, to keep the corridor open.
applications/ch06.txt: The line is not the technology. The line is what the edit does to the corridor the future person will stand in.
applications/ch07.txt: Addiction is a corridor narrowed faster than alternatives could be widened.
applications/ch08.txt: The operator's modelling must be able to integrate what the augmentation delivers. Where it can, permitted. Where it cannot, refused.
applications/ch09.txt: The right to exit is the operator's authority over the closing of the operator's own window when the corridor is no longer viable.
applications/ch10.txt: Most degradation is recoverable at low intervention if it is read early. Read early. Correct lightly.
applications/ch11.txt: Force is permissible when, and only when, the parasitic contraction it addresses is verifiably greater than the contraction it produces.
applications/ch12.txt: No authority sets the region. No market alone discovers it. The Ledger reads it.
horizons/ch01.txt: Beauty is the registration of coherence.
horizons/ch02.txt: Music is direct coupling of one operator's interior state to another's through patterned vibration.
horizons/ch03.txt: Play is the training arena for override.
horizons/ch04.txt: A narrative is a compressed record-architecture built to transfer coupling geometry between operators.
horizons/ch05.txt: A word is a reusable compression token. Meaning is the record-pattern the token indexes, held in joint structure between speakers.
horizons/ch06.txt: The building runs while the speaking window is closed.
horizons/ch07.txt: The obligation tracks the window's capacity, not a line drawn at species. The proportionality says how much, not whether.
horizons/ch08.txt: Unitive transcendence is what it feels like when the parsing stops.
horizons/ch09.txt: The corpus's ethic is not species-specific. It is structure-specific. The obligation runs wherever the structure runs.
horizons/ch10.txt: Both readings are consistent with the formalism. Only one is consistent with the axiom.
horizons/ch11.txt: There is no end as such. There is the moment the structures defragment, which is the moment of maximum symmetry, which is the origin.
horizons/ch12.txt: The sacred is the registration of direct contact with the interior.
horizons/ch13.txt: One thing changes. The source of the verdict.
